answer: A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a fleet in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, as each member consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The terrace cap is applied at intake and dune exposes the per-origin counts. At most 5 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a comet tag. Each copy needs 6 hours of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
